summary: Which lifecycle events trigger a webhook POST.
range: Array enum: JOB_COMPLETED | JOB_FAILED (docs also mention JOB_CREATED).
businessRules: events defines: Specify the subscription that you want to subscribe to i.e. receive them on the webhook url configured above. Currently, "JOB\_CREATED", "JOB\_COMPLETED" and "JOB\_FAILED" type events are supported.
Each element in events must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Valid options: JOB_COMPLETED, JOB_FAILED. Each affects solver behavior differently.
Must stay consistent with: options.webhook.url. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
validationRules: A value outside the enum set -> 400.
testingGuidance: Positive: test with events set to "JOB_COMPLETED"
Positive: test with events set to "JOB_FAILED"
